title: Optimized protocol for quantification of nitrite levels in zebrafish tissue samples
author: Caio Maximino
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sabeaan
materials: Re-suspend the supernatant by vortexing, if needed.

steps.title: Prepare Nitrite Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a sodium nitrite (NaNO2) stock solution and store it in an amber flask under refrigeration (2-8 ºC), protected from light.

substeps.instruction: Weight 0.015 g sodium nitrite (NaNO2) in a beaker covered in aluminum foil.
Dilute in 100 mL distilled water using a volumetric flask (1 mL of this solution contains 14.4937 μM nitrite).

steps.title: Prepare Sulfanilamide Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a sulfanilamide stock solution and store it in an amber flask under refrigeration (2-8 ºC), protected from light.

substeps.instruction: Weight 0.5 g sulfanilamide in a beaker covered in aluminum foil.
Dilute in 100 mL of 20% HCl using a volumetric flask.

steps.title: Prepare NED Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare an N-(1-Naphthyl)ethylenediamine (NED) stock solution and store it in an amber flask under refrigeration (2-8 ºC).

substeps.instruction: Weight 0.3 g NED in a beaker covered in aluminum foil.
Dilute in 100 mL 1% HCl using a volumetric flask.

steps.title: Prepare Calibration Standards
steps.instruction: Create serial dilutions of the NaNO2 stock solution in 12x75 mm high clarity polypropylene test tubes (Corning #352063) wrapped in aluminum foil according to the following volumes:

substeps.instruction: Tube 1: 0.0 mL NaNO2, 24.0 mL ddH2O, 0.5 mL Sulfanilamide, 0.5 mL NED (0.0 μM final)
Tube 2: 0.006 mL NaNO2, 23.994 mL ddH2O, 0.5 mL Sulfanilamide, 0.5 mL NED (0.001769 μM final)
Tube 3: 0.012 mL NaNO2, 23.988 mL ddH2O, 0.5 mL Sulfanilamide, 0.5 mL NED (0.003538 μM final)
Tube 4: 0.023 mL NaNO2, 23.977 mL ddH2O, 0.5 mL Sulfanilamide, 0.5 mL NED (0.007077 μM final)
Tube 5: 0.047 mL NaNO2, 23.953 mL ddH2O, 0.5 mL Sulfanilamide, 0.5 mL NED (0.014154 μM final)
Tube 6: 0.093 mL NaNO2, 23.907 mL ddH2O, 0.5 mL Sulfanilamide, 0.5 mL NED (0.028308 μM final)
Tube 7: 0.187 mL NaNO2, 23.813 mL ddH2O, 0.5 mL Sulfanilamide, 0.5 mL NED (0.113232 μM final)
Tube 8: 0.375 mL NaNO2, 23.625 mL ddH2O, 0.5 mL Sulfanilamide, 0.5 mL NED (0.226464 μM final)

steps.title: Measure Calibration Absorbance
steps.instruction: Read the absorbance of each calibration solution using a spectrophotometer.

substeps.instruction: Set spectrophotometer to 543 nm (or 542 nm as noted in sample section).
Perform at least three technical replicates for all analyses.
Thoroughly rinse cuvettes with distilled water between replicates to remove contaminants.

steps.title: Analyze Calibration Data
steps.instruction: Determine linearity and curve parameters using the chemCal package for R.

substeps.instruction: Enter data in two columns: 'x' (concentration) and 'y' (response).
Perform linear regression (lm(y ~ x)) and plot data using calplot(m).
Verify linearity: Correlation coefficients should be > 0.98; check for uniform error distribution and absence of atypical samples.
Calculate Limit of Detection (LOD) using the 'lod' function with alpha = 0.01 and beta = 0.5.
Calculate Limit of Quantification (LOQ) using the 'loq' function, substituting 'your_n' with the number of technical replicates.

steps.title: Assess Assay Precision
steps.instruction: Determine the repeatability (intra-run) and intermediate (inter-run) precision of the assay.

substeps.instruction: Intra-run: Run three technical replicates for the lowest, intermediate, and highest NaNO2 concentrations and calculate the Relative Standard Deviation (RSD = 100 * s / |x̄|).
Inter-run: Run three technical replicates for the lowest, intermediate, and highest NaNO2 concentrations on two different days and assess the RSD.
Note: RSDs higher than 15% indicate low precision.

steps.title: Determine Assay Accuracy
steps.instruction: Calculate accuracy by comparing predicted and measured absorbances.

substeps.instruction: Run a new calibration curve with at least three technical replicates across the entire range.
Generate predicted values using a weighted linear model in chemCal based on the linearity assay weights.
Calculate accuracy for each level using the formula: Accuracy = ([xi - xv] / xv) * 100, where xi is the predicted value and xv is the measured value.

steps.title: Prepare Zebrafish Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Collect and homogenize zebrafish tissue samples.

substeps.instruction: Sacrifice animal with ice-cold water (< 12 ºC) followed by spinal transection.
Carefully dissect the brain and head kidney.
Homogenize tissues in a pool of 5 animals in 500 μL Zebrafish PBS (0.1 M, pH 7.3).
Optional: Tissues can be kept frozen at -20 ºC for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Process Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Extract the supernatant from the homogenized tissue.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples for 10 min at 14,500 rpm.
Collect the supernatant for the assay.

steps.title: Quantify Nitrite in Samples
steps.instruction: Perform the colorimetric assay on the tissue supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 250 μL of the sample to a disposable polystyrene cuvette (G-Biosciences #786-009).
Add 125 μL sulfanilamide solution, vortex, and let rest for 2 min.
Add 125 μL NED solution, vortex, and let rest for 10 min.
Measure absorbance at 542 nm using a spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Calculate Final Nitrite Levels
steps.instruction: Interpolate the nitrite concentration and normalize the data.

substeps.instruction: Determine NO2- levels by interpolating the measured absorbance from the calibration curve using the chemCal 'inverse.predict' function (alpha = 0.01).
Correct the resulting nitrite values by protein levels measured via the Bradford assay.
